class Fields {
  x = 1;
  arrow = () => this.x;
  fn = function () {};
  nested = class {};
  static fn = function () {};
  #private = () => 2;
  privateName() { return this.#private.name; }
}
const fields = new Fields();
console.log(fields.arrow(), fields.arrow.name, fields.fn.name, fields.nested.name, Fields.fn.name, fields.privateName());
console.log(fields);

const field = 7;
class Host {
  field = class { static seen = this.name; static resolve() { return field; } };
}
const host = new Host();
console.log(host.field.seen, host.field.resolve());
